thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired for service= inference-gateway (prod-eu-west-1) — elevated 5xx error rate (5m avg 12%) :rotating_light:
jordan: Acked. Taking lead. @sre-oncall you're on the rotation, FYI
sre-oncall: On it. Quick glance at dashboards — spike starts ~03:08 UTC, concentrated on POST /v1/generate, backend 502/504s mostly
maya: Any recent deploys or config changes?
jordan: There was a traffic-rollout at 03:02 shifting weight to model-variant-b (traffic-manager). I'll check rollout history
jordan: rollout log: `traffic-manager show rollout inference-gateway --last 1` -> shows variant-b weight ramped to 60% at 03:02
infra-ops: Can we divert traffic from eu-west while we triage? Runbook suggests traffic-manager route change or scale up 
maya: +1 for temporary reroute. Also check KV cache eviction patterns, last-week we've seen cache churn causing backend timeouts
jordan: Executing gradual rollback of routing weight: `traffic-manager set-weight inference-gateway model-variant-b 0.2` -> monitor
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by jordan
sre-oncall: After dropping weight to 20% errors dropped to ~4% in 90s. Dropped further to 0% after weight -> 0% and redirect to eu-central. Looks like variant-b is the problem
jordan: Performed full traffic shift to eu-central (eu-west weight 0). Observability shows error rate back to baseline ~0.6%
infra-ops: Scaling eu-west pool +2 while we keep it drained: `./infra/scale --pool eu-west --delta 2` (override autoscaler)
customer-success: FYI: Acme Inc saw failures in the 03:07-03:10 window, opening a support note to them now
maya: Opening a short investigation ticket: triage shows variant-b binary + quantization change landed 02:58, aligns with timeline
sre-oncall: Immediate mitigation done. Next steps: revert variant-b image in CI, add canary error-rate guard to rollout pipeline, smaller ramp steps
jordan: Will capture timeline and actions in a post-incident doc. I'll keep the channel open for 20m of observation
infra-ops: Follow-ups: (1) revert variant-b in deploy history, (2) add canary health check to traffic-manager, (3) notify affected customers
jordan: Thanks everyone — great quick response. :thumbsup:
notes: automated pager, oncall ack, routing rollback, traffic shift, scale-up, customer impact noted
